name: Mariendal Friskole
profile: Small Copenhagen friskole (independent primary school) for grades 0-9 (bornehaveklasse to 9. klasse, ~132 pupils). Secondary sources describe a values profile centered on safety, anti-bullying and 'livsduelighed' (life skills) with a stated Christian worldview, but this could not be confirmed on the school's own site.
notes: The school's own website (www.mariendalfriskole.dk, plain http, and its skoleintra/skoleporten subsites) could not be reached despite many attempts (SSL handshake failure, expired/mismatched certificate, and finally connection refused on port 443) — the site appears to be down or blocking automated fetches. No current fee figures could be found anywhere online. A third-party blog (pressenet.dk) references a 2016/17 enrollment fee of 1,500 kr and a c. 2017 monthly fee around 1,370 kr (noting fees are typically index-regulated, +10-20 kr/yr), plus a 'Christian worldview' description — these are unverified secondary-source claims only, not confirmed on an official page, so they were NOT used for the numeric fields. Grades 0-9 and pupil count confirmed via the Ministry of Education's uddannelsesstatistik.dk page. Recommend contacting the school directly (33 22 72 20 / kontoret@mariendalfriskole.dk) for current pricing.

name: Copenhagen City School
siblingDiscount: 2 siblings: 2,860 kr/month combined; 3+ siblings: 3,620 kr/month combined (slightly higher if a sibling is in 9. klasse). Enrollment fee is reduced to 1,000 kr for the 3rd+ child.
profile: Copenhagen City School is a Danish-medium friskole (grades 0-9) with a multicultural, international profile and a strong emphasis on English throughout the curriculum; applicants must already be able to manage in Danish.
waitlist: Varies by grade (as of research date): few openings in 0. klasse and 1.-3. klasse and in 5./7.-8. klasse; active waitlists for 4., 6. and 9. klasse.
notes: Fee for 1st grade (part of the 0.-8. tier) is 1,700 kr/mdr over 12 months; 9. klasse is billed 2,025 kr/mdr over 11 months (Aug-June) instead. A class fund fee of 100 kr is collected twice a year, separate from tuition. Kindergarten (0. klasse) has its own 500 kr non-refundable registration fee, distinct from the 1,500 kr general enrollment fee. Deposit equal to 2 months' tuition is also required (refundable under conditions). No explicit school year was stated on the fee page; figures reflect the live site as fetched.

name: Al-Huda Skolen
profile: Al-Huda Skolen is an Islamic private school (friskole) in Copenhagen NV, grades 0-9 (founded 1996), teaching the standard Danish curriculum alongside Arabic language, Quran and Islamic studies, while explicitly emphasizing integration into Danish society, a 'moderate' interpretation of Islam, and rejection of extremism.
waitlist: Admission requires submitting a profile/readiness description from the current institution plus an admission interview/assessment; the school states Arabic is not required to enroll. No specific queue length published; uses ventelisten.net for sign-up.
notes: No fee tiering by grade was found (same rate for all grades). Additional yearly materials fee of 1,000 kr (billed in August). Administration fee is listed as 0 kr. School requires enrollment in a PBS-based supplementary accident insurance scheme (cost not published). No school year was stated on the fee page. Arabic is taught as a subject alongside Danish-medium instruction of standard subjects; not confirmed as full dual-medium instruction.

name: Børne U.N.I.
siblingDiscount: 2nd child pays 85% of school/SFO fees, 3rd child pays 60%, 4th child pays 60%.
profile: Børne U.N.I. (Børneuniversitetet på Vesterbro) is a 'lilleskole' (member of Lilleskolernes Sammenslutning) in central Copenhagen using project- and design-based, child-driven pedagogy with age-mixed learning groups, grades 0-9 (~300 pupils).
waitlist: No open places currently available ('Vi har ingen ledige pladser pt.' stated on the admissions page as of research date). Joining the waitlist costs 400 kr.
notes: The single monthly fee explicitly covers both schooling AND SFO/afternoon care for all grades regardless of actual SFO use, so no separate SFO figure is published — hence sfoMonthlyDKK is null rather than bundled incorrectly. In addition to the 400 kr waitlist fee, a 9,000 kr deposit is required (2,000 kr on confirmation of a place + 7,000 kr due the following April 1), refundable on withdrawal under conditions. The school's own live payment page explicitly states these rates are for skoleåret 2023-2024 — no more recent figure was found online, so this may be outdated; treat with caution and verify directly with the school. Income-based fee subsidy ('fripladstilskud') is available.

name: Al Quds Skole
siblingDiscount: Not a percentage discount but per-child tiered pricing: 1. barn 850 kr/mdr, 2. barn 750 kr/mdr, 3. barn 650 kr/mdr, 4. barn 550 kr/mdr, 5. barn 450 kr/mdr.
profile: Al Quds Skole is a bilingual/multicultural friskole in Copenhagen, grades 0-9, teaching entirely in Danish and emphasizing democratic values, human rights, gender equality and integration of bilingual pupils. Despite its name (Arabic for Jerusalem), the school's own materials describe no explicit religious/Islamic instruction.
notes: Fees are charged in 11 installments regardless of holidays (school year not explicitly stated on the fee page). Additional one-time family deposit of 1,000 kr plus a 200 kr registration fee (both distinct from the 850 kr/mdr tuition). Annual materials fee of 200 kr billed each August. A 30 kr admin surcharge applies to giro-card payments.

name: Al-Hilal Skolen
siblingDiscount: Not a percentage discount but a tiered family fee: 1 barn 1,000 kr/mdr, 2 børn 1,800 kr/mdr, 3 børn 2,400 kr/mdr, 4 børn 2,800 kr/mdr, 5 børn 3,000 kr/mdr (family total, not additive per child). SFO similarly tiered: 500 kr/mdr (1 child), 900 kr/mdr (2 children), 1,200 kr/mdr (3 children).
profile: Al-Hilal Skolen is a single-track Islamic friskole in Copenhagen NV (founded 2003, ~190 pupils, grades 0-9), combining the standard Danish curriculum with Islamic studies and Arabic, and emphasizing diversity, tolerance and democratic citizenship.
waitlist: Uses an external sign-up system (ventelisten.net/101526) for the waitlist; queue length not published. An enrollment form for skoleåret 2027/2028 was already open as of the research date (Sept 2026).
notes: IMPORTANT: the domain given in the task, www.al-hilal.dk, is dead (DNS resolution fails entirely). The school's actual live website is https://alhilalskolen.dk/ — same school (Svanevej 3, 2400 Kbh. NV, phone 35820760), confirmed via matching address/phone in a bilingual Danish/Arabic PDF enrollment form found on that site. That PDF (for skoleåret 2027/2028) is the only place fees were found — no dedicated 'skolepenge' page exists in the site's main navigation. Fees also include a 1,000 kr one-time family deposit (depositum) plus the 300 kr/child indskrivningsgebyr, and a separate yearly materials fee of 500 kr/child (paid in July). Income-based fee subsidy ('fripladstilskud') available.

name: Waldorf Skolen i København
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,779 DKK/month; 3rd child: 1,442 DKK/month
profile: Waldorf (Steiner) school in Copenhagen offering anthroposophic pedagogy for grades 1-9, with emphasis on arts, crafts, rhythm, and holistic child development; runs an affiliated Soria Moria kindergarten for younger children.
gradesOffered: 1-9 (plus affiliated Soria Moria kindergarten for pre-school ages)
waitlist: 250 DKK/year fee to hold a place on the kindergarten-class waiting list; school 'endeavors' to give sibling priority but does not guarantee it.
notes: Fees charged in 11 installments (Aug-June); indexed annually each Aug 1. One-time 5,000 DKK enrollment fee (charged Dec) plus a separate 10,000 DKK refundable parental capital deposit (charged March, refunded when last child leaves). SFO (0.-3. klasse) 1,395 DKK/month. Optional instrument lessons 479 DKK/month + 236 DKK instrument rental. Soria Moria kindergarten (separate from the school proper) charges 3,508-3,891 DKK/month over 12 months depending on child's age.

name: Vanløse Friskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 2,039 DKK/month; 3rd child: 1,855 DKK/month
profile: Danish friskole (independent primary school) in Vanløse, Copenhagen, with small classes (max 18 pupils in 0.-3. kl., 24 in 4.-9. kl.), a pronounced daily-music profile, and a values-based ('mind and heart') community pedagogy with twice-yearly Danish/maths testing.
waitlist: 5-step admission process (waitlist registration, interview, 2-week trial, staff assessment, enrollment); 475 DKK waitlist registration fee; some listings indicated open spots in grade 1 and above.
notes: Additional one-time costs at enrollment: 1,000 DKK trial-week fee and 3,000 DKK (non-refundable) for books/materials. 175 DKK/month admin surcharge if not paying via PBS direct debit. Withdrawal requires paying the current month plus 2 extra months for school and SFO. Pedagogy tag 'grundtvig-kold' is inferred from the school's traditional friskole community/values framing (e.g. harvest-festival traditions) rather than an explicit statement on the site, so treat with some caution — could also be read as a general 'lilleskole'-type friskole.

name: Øresunds Internationale Skole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,130 DKK/month (enrollment fee 1,600 DKK); 3rd child: 750 DKK/month (enrollment fee 1,000 DKK); 4th child: 590 DKK/month
profile: Despite its name, this is a Danish-medium, parent-driven independent free school (friskole, est. 2003) in Amager/Copenhagen serving grades 0.-9., offering individualized/self-paced instruction, substantially more English teaching than standard Danish public schools, French as a second foreign language from grade 6, and mother-tongue instruction for multilingual pupils.
curriculum: Danish (Fælles Mål-aligned) with enhanced English instruction; French introduced from grade 6
notes: Monthly fee (1,375 DKK) includes school books and materials. No school year was stated on the fee page itself (retrieved Sept 2026; page footer copyright reads '2017-2026'). SFO: full-time (13:30-16:30) 650 DKK/month, part-time (≤5h/week) 450 DKK/month. Admission is via direct application/meeting with the school (typically booked 6-12 months ahead); no formal public waitlist portal was found. Not to be confused with an English-medium international school — teaching is in Danish, unlike International School of Hellerup.

name: Ørestad Friskole
profile: Danish friskole (independent primary school) in Ørestad, Amager, Copenhagen, serving grades 0.-9./10. with strong exam results (2025 average grade 9.4 vs. national average 7.2). Pedagogy emphasizes project-based, student-centred learning, close school-home cooperation, real-world projects with local businesses/institutions, and themes of sustainability and digital literacy.
waitlist: Admission is waitlist-based; the school holds an information meeting roughly 1.5 years before school start for the 0. class intake, followed by an application form. A third-party summary (not independently verified) mentioned a 300 DKK waiting-list registration fee.
notes: IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the school's official website (oerestad-friskole.dk) redirects entirely to a JavaScript-rendered Skoleporten site (oerestad-friskole.skoleporten.dk) that returned HTTP 403 on every direct fetch attempt, including its dedicated 'Skolepenge' and 'SFO' menu entries, so exact fee figures could NOT be verified from the primary source despite the school clearly charging fees. An unverified third-party aggregator snippet mentioned an annual fee around 31,380 DKK (~2,600-2,850 DKK/month equivalent), but this is deliberately excluded here per instructions against reporting unverified numbers. School is confirmed open and operating: 228 pupils, ~22.8 pupils/class (2025), headmaster Ingelise Tingdal Rasmussen. Contact: info@oerestad-friskole.dk, +45 33 12 81 81, Nordre Digevej 6, 2300 København S. Recommend contacting the school directly for current fees.

name: Salix Skole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,200 DKK/month; 3rd child: 1,000 DKK/month; 4th child: 800 DKK/month
profile: Danish independent primary school (fri/privat grundskole) in Valby, Copenhagen, founded 2006, serving grades 0.-9. with a strong academic and character-education focus ('life-capable, self-governing citizens'), small classes (max ~20 pupils), and reading/maths support initiatives; no stated religious affiliation.
notes: Rates effective as of Jan 1, 2026 (within the 2025/26 school year). SFO/bus fee (950 DKK/month) is charged 11 months (excluding July), while school fees are charged 12 months. Pre-school SFO: 1,500 DKK/month. The 1,500 DKK enrollment fee is non-refundable. A 300 DKK/month surcharge applies if paying by giro card/cash/MobilePay instead of PBS direct debit. Families can apply annually (deadline Sept 15) for income-based fee subsidies.

name: International School of Hellerup
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: -350 DKK/month; 3rd child: -650 DKK/month; 4th child: -1,150 DKK/month
profile: English-medium, not-for-profit international school in Hellerup offering the full IB continuum (PYP, MYP, Diploma Programme) plus a separate Danish STX upper-secondary track; partially subsidized by the Danish state for pupils with a registered CPR number.
curriculum: IB (PYP/MYP/DP), plus a separate Danish STX track for upper-secondary
gradesOffered: Pre-K through DP2/Grade 12 (IB continuum), plus Danish STX
notes: Fee shown (3,785 DKK/month) is for the 'Kindergarten - PYP5' tier (covers grade-1 equivalent), with CPR registered before 1 Sept 2026; without CPR the rate is 6,500 DKK/month for any grade. Other 2026-27 tiers: Pre-Kindergarten 5,295 DKK/month (+750 DKK mandatory lunch fee), MYP 1-5 3,990 DKK/month, DP 1-2 4,190 DKK/month (+300 DKK/month IB fee). One-time fees: 2,000 DKK application fee + 1,500 DKK enrollment fee + 9,000 DKK refundable school deposit. Fees payable 12 months (Aug-July), except DP2 (Aug-June). After School Care Programme (ASCP, full-time) 1,630 DKK/month, Aug-June (11 months); Morning Club only 510 DKK/month. Fees indexed annually (min. 2% increase). Danish STX fees published separately at stx.ish.dk/ny-elev/skolepenge. Source data drawn from 'Schedule of Main School Fees 2026-2027' PDF linked from the tuition-fees page.

name: Frederik Barfods Skole
profile: One of Denmark's oldest independent primary schools (founded 1834), named after the 19th-century Grundtvigian historian/politician Frederik Barfod. Offers grades 0.-9. with personalized learning plans, an anti-bullying strategy, and a 'Move Yourself' PE-focused program for older students.
waitlist: Free to register on the school's waiting list (no signup fee).
notes: fbs.dk itself could not be fetched directly (TLS/cert mismatch pointing to skoleintra.dk, and skoleporten pages return 403 to automated fetches), so figures come from indexed page content. The 'Indmeldelse og venteliste' page indicates 1,900 kr/month over 12 months and a 1,500 kr deposit due at start of 0. klasse or mid-program entry. An older/cached snippet from a different page suggested 1,300 kr/month school fee and 1,300/700 kr SFO, which may be outdated - not used as primary figure. SFO price could not be confirmed with confidence, left null. Fee covers most costs except grade 4-9 computers and class trips.

name: Kaptajn Johnsens Skole
profile: Private independent primary school (friskole) in Frederiksberg with the motto 'Tryghed - Læring - Ordentlighed' (Safety - Learning - Decency). Grades 0.-9. No distinct alternative pedagogy (e.g. Montessori/religious) identified; academically high-performing (average grade ~9.4, well above national average).
waitlist: Admission via the national waitlist system at ventelisten.net/147018; school also publishes a 'Vejledning til venteliste' guide.
notes: NOT FOUND: exact fee figures could not be confirmed. The school's Skolepenge page confirms fee documents exist ('Fordelingsnøgle skolepenge 2026-27', 'Fordelingsnøgle SFO-betaling 2026-27', 'Ansøgningsskema 2026-27' for subsidy applications) but these are Cloudflare/JS-protected 'Fullscreen' documents that returned 403 Forbidden to all automated fetch attempts (direct and via reader proxy). An unverified third-party aggregator (proff.dk) surfaced a '25,200 kr' figure in a search snippet, but this could not be corroborated against the school's own materials (unclear if annual/monthly or even the correct metric), so per instructions it was NOT used - left null rather than guessed. Site appears active and is a legitimate, currently operating private primary school (434 students, grades 0-9).

name: Prins Henriks Skole, Lycee Francais De Copenhague
siblingDiscount: Sibling fee reduction programs are mentioned as available; specific percentage/amount not published.
profile: The French international school in Copenhagen (Lycée Français Prins Henrik), part of the AEFE network of French schools abroad. Follows the French national curriculum from maternelle through lycée and prepares students for both French and Danish exams; ~800 students from 46 nationalities on one campus in Frederiksberg.
waitlist: Rolling admissions via an online application (Skolengo); students from non-French curricula must pass a French-language/placement entrance assessment. No specific wait-time published.
notes: monthlyFeeDKK of 2,877.27 DKK/month is the published 2026-27 'subsidized' rate for Elementaire (CP-CM2, i.e. roughly Danish 0./1. through 5./6. klasse) - the lowest tier offered for primary grades; non-subsidized rates are 'significantly higher' but not quantified on the pages fetched. Other tiers found: Kindergarten (TPS-PS-MS) 3,266.36 DKK/mo, Middle school (6e-3e) 3,318.18 DKK/mo, 10th grade (2nde) 3,465.45 DKK/mo. Registration costs beyond the 4,950 DKK first enrollment fee: 750 DKK non-refundable application fee, plus a 2,500 DKK security deposit. Number of monthly installments per year (10 vs 12) not confirmed - the source presented the tuition already as a monthly figure without stating the annual billing cadence.

name: Frederiksberg Friskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,167 DKK/month; 3rd child: 655 DKK/month (tiered reduced fees rather than a percentage discount).
profile: A Grundtvig-Kold tradition friskole ('børneskole') built around 'levende vekselvirkning' (living interaction) and 'livsoplysning' (life enlightenment), emphasizing respect for childhood as valuable in itself rather than mere preparation for adulthood.
notes: As a 'børneskole' the school does not offer classes past 7. klasse. Fee includes books and materials; a 100 DKK class fund is charged each August; withdrawal requires 1 month's notice. SFO (808 DKK/month, 12 installments) runs 14:00-16:30 and covers roughly 0.-5. klasse. School year for these prices not explicitly stated on the fetched page (site fetched live, so figures are presumed current). Page could only be reliably read via a reader-proxy fetch; direct WebFetch was blocked by the site's bot-protection (403).

name: Hovedstadens Privatskoler, Jakobskolen
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,545 DKK/month school fee, 1,085 DKK/month SFO; 3rd and subsequent children: 1,085 DKK/month school fee.
profile: A Christian private school on Frederiksberg built around 'fordybelse' (deep focus/immersion) and 'fællesskab' (community); motto 'Et trygt sted at være - et trygt sted at lære' (A safe place to be, a safe place to learn).
waitlist: Admission via separate application pathways for preschool/0. klasse vs. already-established grades; early entry to 0. klasse possible via individual assessment for children turning 5 before Oct 1.
notes: Page explicitly states 'Skolepenge pr. måned for skoleåret 2026-27 (i 12 mdr.)'. No enrollment/registration fee was found on the priser page. Families experiencing financial hardship can apply for 'økonomisk friplads' (need-based tuition assistance). SFO covers grades 0-3; a separate 'Fritidsklub' exists for grades 4-9 (price not found).

name: Johannesskolen
siblingDiscount: 2nd child pays 75% of the fee for their grade level; 3rd and subsequent children attend free.
profile: An ecumenical, non-denominational Christian private school ('folkekirkeligt grundlag') founded in 1910 by the Christian School Association (Den Kristelige Skoleforening). Grades 0.-9., organized into lower (0.-3.), middle (4.-6.) and upper (7.-9.) school units, with a strong Cambridge English program alongside the standard Danish curriculum.
notes: monthlyFeeDKK of 1,955 DKK/month applies to grades 0.-3.; grades 4.-9. are 2,155 DKK/month (higher tier). Fees are billed in 11 monthly installments (July free). Enrollment costs: 500 DKK fee charged when the child starts, plus a 3,000 DKK deposit paid in two 1,500 DKK installments (2 years and 1 year before start). SFO priced in 4 tiers by weekly hours: Tier 1 (1-9h) 1,045 DKK, Tier 2 (10-13h) 1,390 DKK, Tier 3 (14-18h) 1,835 DKK, Tier 4 (19h+) 2,235 DKK/month, 11 payments/year; summer SFO 135 DKK/day. Monthly camp-school (lejrskole) surcharges apply for grades 3, 5, 7, 8-9 (75-150 DKK/month, July free). Note: an older cached search snippet showed different figures (grades 0-6: 2,030 DKK, grades 7-9: 2,130 DKK) - the directly-fetched current site (johsskolen.dk, dated for school year 2026/27) was used as the primary, more current source instead.

name: Busses Skole
profile: A small, traditional independent primary and lower-secondary school (friskole) in Gentofte, non-denominational, emphasizing community, well-being and integrating academic learning with social and creative activities (camps, theatre weeks, cross-grade assemblies).
waitlist: Admission via an online waiting-list sign-up (opskrivning til venteliste); no specific wait times published.
notes: The school's fee documents ('Skolepengesats pr. 1. januar 2026', SFO/friplads distribution keys) are hosted on the skoleporten.dk subdomain behind Cloudflare bot-protection and returned HTTP 403 on every direct fetch attempt (tried direct WebFetch, a read-proxy, and curl with a browser user-agent). General web search also failed to surface the actual DKK figures — results only confirmed that fee-rate documents exist for 1 Jan 2025 and 1 Jan 2026 without quoting amounts. School offers means-tested fee reductions ('friplads') for both skolepenge and SFO. Confirmed active/open with 312 students, grades from begynderklasse through 9th (expanding upper school to two classes from 2027-28).

name: Rygaards Skole
siblingDiscount: Fee decreases per additional sibling enrolled simultaneously: 2nd child 40,150 DKK/yr (3,650/mo), 3rd child 30,250 DKK/yr (2,750/mo), 4th child 25,850 DKK/yr (2,350/mo), vs. 42,350 DKK/yr (3,850/mo) for the 1st child.
profile: A Catholic school in Hellerup founded in 1909 by the Assumption Sisters, run as two parallel departments under one roof: the Danish-medium Rygaards Danske Skole and the English-medium, internationally accredited Rygaards International School.
curriculum: Danish national curriculum (Danish department); international curriculum aligned with Cambridge/NEASC/ECIS standards through Year 11 (International department)
notes: Figures are for the International Department, academic year 2025/26, billed in 11 monthly instalments (no payment due in July). The 'Nth child' tiers refer to the number of siblings simultaneously enrolled at Rygaards, not grade level. Reception class (youngest) fee is higher and separate: 95,700 DKK/yr (8,700/mo), no sibling reduction, plus reception after-care 23,100 DKK/yr (2,100/mo). Year 7-11 pay a 4,675 DKK/yr supplement; Year 7-9 pay an additional 6,050 DKK/yr travel supplement. One-time new-student fees: Application 2,000 DKK, Enrollment 2,000 DKK, Deposit 15,000 DKK. A separate, lower fee schedule likely applies to the Danish department but was not located/confirmed on the sources checked.

name: Sct. Joseph Søstrenes Skole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: full price; 3rd child: 50% of the fee; 4th child: free (per current sjss.dk page).
profile: A Catholic private primary school in Charlottenlund/Gentofte, part of Denmark's network of Catholic parish schools, building its work on the Catholic-Christian view of humanity and education ('menneskesyn' and 'dannelsesideal'); SFO is called 'Spiren'.
notes: Current official site (sjss.dk/ny-elev) states 2,480 DKK/month for the 1st/2nd child (12 months/yr), 2,580 DKK/month for grades 7-8, SFO 1,680 DKK/month; sibling discount 2nd child full price, 3rd child 50%, 4th free; enrollment/admin fee 1,000 DKK. An older, differently-worded page on the retired sct-joseph.skoleporten.dk site (dated 'effective 1 March 2024') showed lower figures — 2,220 DKK/month with sibling discounts of 75%/50%/0% and SFO at 1,640 DKK — which appear to be superseded. The exact label of the current school year was not explicitly stated on the page; assumed 2025/26. Grades offered (0.-9. klasse) not explicitly confirmed on the fetched pages — inferred from the standard structure of Danish Catholic parish schools; the 'grades 7-8' fee tier confirms the school runs at least through 8th grade.

name: Rudolf Steiner skolen i Gentofte, Vidar Skolen
siblingDiscount: 2nd child pays a reduced rate: 1,591 DKK/month school fee (vs 2,166 for 1st child) and 870 DKK/month SFO (vs 1,573).
profile: A Rudolf Steiner (Waldorf) school in Gentofte spanning nursery through upper secondary (10th grade plus a 2-year Vidar HF programme), emphasizing equal weight on academics, art, music and crafts, with less focus on grades and traditional testing.
waitlist: Online waiting lists for nursery/kindergarten and for grundskole places; site noted open spots for HF and 10th grade for August 2026 entry.
notes: Prices shown are for the 2026/27 school year, billed over 11 months/year (July is payment-free). A 1,000 DKK enrollment fee applies to new students joining from certain higher grades onward, per the source wording ('for nye elever i følgende klasser'), rather than to all new entrants. Income-assessed fee reduction ('friplads') is available for both school fees and play-group payments, based on 2025 tax-year income.

name: Kildegård Privatskole
siblingDiscount: Full fee for the 1st and 2nd child; 3rd child 50% of the fee; from the 4th child onward, 33⅓% of the fee per child (applies when siblings attend simultaneously).
profile: A classic private primary and lower-secondary school in Hellerup (Gentofte) offering a broad traditional Danish curriculum including languages, sciences, humanities and the arts, plus a homework café and an in-house music school.
notes: Monthly fee is 2,150 DKK for børnehaveklasse (0.) through 5. klasse, rising to 2,500 DKK/month for 6.-9. klasse, effective from 1 January 2026, billed 12 months/year; school year runs 1 August-31 July, so this rate applies mid-way through the 2025/26 school year and into 2026/27. Enrollment fee of 1,500 DKK is forfeited if the child is later withdrawn. Income-based fee reduction available on application to the school office by 1 September each year.

name: Copenhagen International School
profile: A large, English-medium international IB World School located in Nordhavn, Copenhagen, serving PreK through Grade 12 across the full IB continuum (PYP, MYP, DP); caps enrollment so no single nationality exceeds 25% of the student body.
waitlist: Rolling, holistic 4-step admissions process (tour, application, review, registration); currently accepting applications for the 2027-2028 school year and maintains a waiting pool with priority groups when specific grades are full.
notes: Annual tuition for Kindergarten-Grade 5 (lowest 'grade school' tier) is DKK 151,000 for 2025/26; monthlyFeeDKK of ~12,583 is a computed average (151,000/12) — CIS does not bill strictly monthly, families choose 1, 4, or 8 instalment plans spread from April to February (4- and 8-payment plans carry a 2,000 DKK admin fee). Other tuition tiers: Pre-K (2,3,4): 189,000 DKK/yr; Grades 6-10: 174,000 DKK/yr; Grades 11-12: 210,000 DKK/yr. New-student fees: 3,000 DKK non-refundable application fee plus this 40,000 DKK non-refundable registration fee (one-time). After School Club for grades K-5: 1,100 DKK/month (pickup by 16:00) or 2,000 DKK/month (until 16:55); free supervision to 17:00 included in tuition for Pre-K. Lunch, after-school activities, sports and trips billed separately (examples: activities 1,200-2,500 DKK/semester; sports 3,000-4,400 DKK/yr).

name: Den Lille Skole
siblingDiscount: 20% reduction for 2nd child, 50% reduction for 3rd child and beyond
profile: Denmark's oldest 'lilleskole' (founded 1949/1950 by parents opposed to folkeskole pedagogy). A small progressive free school where community and artistic subjects (music, theatre, art, movement, cooking) are prioritized alongside core academics; the after-school club (Klubben) is pedagogically integrated with the school day.
notes: Fee is 2,130 kr./month for bh.kl.-9.kl., stated as effective 'pr. 01.01.2025' and billed 12 months/year (grade 9 has a free July). Adjusted annually each Jan 1 by price index; page had not shown a newer 2026 figure as of this research (Sept 2026), so the current rate may be slightly higher. SFO (0.-3. kl.) is 1,340 kr./month, 12 months. Enrollment fee = 1 month's combined skolepenge+SFO for grades 0-3 (≈3,470 kr.) or 1 month's skolepenge only for grades 4-9 (2,130 kr.). School states fees are all-inclusive with no extra activity charges beyond a 9th-grade trip.

name: Kvikmarkens Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 2nd child school fee 1,800 kr/month; 3rd+ child 1,690 kr/month; SFO 2nd+ sibling 1,050 kr/month
profile: Small private school in Gladsaxe/Søborg with no political or religious affiliation, two classes per grade (max 20 pupils/class) from kindergarten to 9th grade. Emphasizes wellbeing, differentiated teaching and solid academic competence alongside democratic/civic formation.
waitlist: Waiting lists exist for several classes, including beginner (0. klasse) classes; early registration recommended. One-time waiting-list fee 300 kr. (non-refundable).
notes: Fees paid over 12 installments, August-July, for 2026. Camp-school (lejrskole) parent contributions capped at 1 month's fee for grades 0-8, 2 months for grade 9. Students must supply their own PC from 4th grade onward. 384 pupils.

name: Gladsaxe Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 25% off 2nd child (school fee 1,641 kr; SFO 1,024 kr); 50% off 3rd child (school fee 1,095 kr); school offers a 'søskendegaranti' (sibling guarantee)
profile: Non-denominational, non-political mainstream private school with one class per grade level (bhkl.-9. kl.), roughly 20 pupils/class. Focuses on pupil wellbeing as a precondition for learning, aiming to form 'life-skilled, responsible' children via seven core competence areas.
waitlist: No formal waitlist described; school instead lists 'ledige pladser' (available places) and an online enrollment/sign-up form, with an 'admission procedure' (procedure for indmeldelse).
notes: School fee 2,188 kr/month effective 1 Jan 2026, paid over 12 months. SFO 'Regnbuen' fee 1,365 kr/month effective 1 Aug 2026 (start of 2026/27 school year); children auto-enrolled in SFO from K through July of 3rd-grade year. One-time class-fund contribution of 200 kr. collected in August (or pro-rated mid-year). Extra monthly savings contributions collected in specific grades to fund overnight camp-school trips (grades 3, 6, 9). 183 pupils as of Sept 2026.

name: Bagsværd Friskole
profile: A friskole in the Grundtvig-Kold free-school tradition (based on its stated values), emphasizing community ('fællesskab'), creativity, storytelling and student/class democracy. Organized into indskoling, mellemtrin, and overbygning (grades 7-9).
waitlist: Admission handled via a waiting list at Ventelisten.net (school code 159018); a non-refundable 475 kr. administration fee is charged at sign-up; an information meeting is held in Sept/Oct the year before a child is due to start.
notes: Could NOT confirm current monthly tuition despite extensive attempts. The school's fee page (bagsvardfriskole.dk/skolepenge) was archived by the Wayback Machine as recently as July 2025 but returns HTTP 404 on the live site now (Sept 2026), indicating the site was restructured/redesigned and the fee page removed or moved to a non-guessable URL; no dropdown/JS-rendered sub-navigation for 'Til Forældre' could be retrieved via static fetch. Third-party aggregators (skolegang.dk, privateskoler.dk, uddannelsesstatistik.dk) also do not publish this school's fee figures. Only the 475 kr. non-refundable waiting-list admin fee was confirmed (at https://www.bagsvardfriskole.dk/praktisk/venteliste). Do NOT treat the 'Den Lille Skole' or 'Kvikmarken' figures as a proxy — no number should be assumed for this school. Recommend contacting the school directly (44 98 43 35 / kontor@b-friskole.dk) for current pricing. 203 pupils, ~20.2 pupils/class, school not otherwise flagged as closed/merged.

name: Bagsværd Gymnasiums Grundskole
siblingDiscount: 250 kr./month reduction per child for families with multiple children in the SFO 'Birken' (begynderklasse-3. klasse)
profile: Grundskole (primary/lower-secondary, begynderklasse to 0.g) department of Bagsværd Kostskole og Gymnasium, a private self-governing institution combining a day/boarding grundskole with an STX gymnasium. Academic culture built on community ('fællesskab'), academic rigor ('faglighed') and integrity ('ordentlighed'), with sports/talent tracks (e.g. Science6) from 7th grade.
notes: Website bagkost.dk (as given) is the correct, live, current website — it is the site for 'Bagsværd Kostskole og Gymnasium,' of which institution 159034 'Bagsværd Gymnasiums Grundskole' is the primary/lower-secondary department; not dead or misidentified. (The https:// version of bagkost.dk was blocked by the research agent's fetch tool for domain-verification reasons; the http:// version worked and returned identical content.) Fee shown (2,160 kr/month, 25,920 kr/year) is for Begynderklasse-6. klasse, effective 1 Jan 2026; 7. klasse-0.g costs 2,220 kr/month (26,640 kr/year) instead. SFO 'Birken' (Begynderklasse-5. klasse) is 1,650 kr/month plus a mandatory cafeteria/meal charge of 92 kr/month. Enrollment fee 3,000 kr includes 2 months' advance tuition (Aug-Sep). Tuition billed across all 12 months including July. Camp-school trip costs range 1,200-5,600 kr depending on grade (2025 prices). 718 pupils, avg. class size 23.3, average exam grade 8.7/12 (well above national average of 7.2).

name: Atheneskolen
profile: A niche school exclusively for highly gifted children, admission based on documented high cognitive ability (WISC-V testing). Combines academically rigorous, advanced-level teaching (culture, logic, language) with strong emphasis on emotional safety and social belonging for gifted pupils. Moved to new premises on Lundtoftevej near DTU, Kgs. Lyngby, in summer 2025.
waitlist: Waiting-list registration costs 1,500 kr. Admission requires a WISC-V giftedness assessment and typically a 14-day trial period (1,500 kr.); a 14-day pre-school program is also available (1,500 kr.).
notes: No explicit school-year/effective-date was stated on the fee page itself, so feeYear is left null (figures reflect the live site as of Sept 2026). SFO & Mini Club (grades 0-4) is 1,600 kr/month; a separate after-school 'Club' for grades 5-9 costs 540 kr/month. Enrollment/admission fee (optagelsesgebyr) is 1,500 kr.; the school's own fee page also lists a refundable deposit (depositum) of 8,100 kr. An earlier, less reliable web-search summary (not the school's own fee page) mentioned a different 'parental deposit' of 30,000 kr (couples) / 15,000 kr (single parents) — this could NOT be verified directly on the school's site and may be outdated or inaccurate; treat the 8,100 kr depositum from the direct fee-page fetch as the more trustworthy figure. Additional parent costs cited: computers from grade 6 (2,000-10,000 kr), grade 7 trip contribution (2,000-3,000 kr), grade 9 international trip (4,000-5,000 kr). 2025 enrollment data shows pupils in grades 1-9 only (216 total); no 0. klasse cohort was recorded that year, though a pre-school trial program exists. Grade range based on 2025 enrolment snapshot (grades 1-9); could not confirm from the school's own site whether a kindergarten class (0. kl.) is formally offered.

name: Hareskovens Lilleskole
siblingDiscount: 340 kr/month reduction for 2nd child; 580 kr/month reduction for 3rd child (same address)
profile: A Danish friskole ('lilleskole') emphasizing that creativity, personal/social development and high academic standards reinforce one another; organized in three divisions (Lilleafdeling 0.-3.kl, Mellemafdeling 4.-6.kl, Overbygning 7.-9.kl) with project- and workshop-based teaching.
waitlist: Admits two bh.kl. (0th grade) classes per year as of Aug 2024; see school's admissions page for waitlist procedure.
notes: Fee tiered by division and rises with grade: bh.kl-3.kl: Skole 779 + FTO(after-school) 1.798 + madordning (lunch+morning snack) 668 + eftermiddagsmad 31 = 3.276 kr/month total; 4.-6.kl: Skole 2.125 + Klub 452 + madordning 668 + eftermiddagsmad 31; 7.-9.kl: Skole 2.608 + madordning 668 (no club). monthlyFeeDKK/sfoMonthlyDKK above reflect the bh.kl-3.kl (1st grade) tier. Also: 300 kr/year support-association fee per family, plus trip-related costs (field trip meal money, ~100 kr/year transport, and ~one month's skolepenge for 7-8th grade overseas trips). Income-based payment plans/partial scholarships available on request.

name: Ballerup Ny Skole
siblingDiscount: 30% off base fee + SFO for 2nd child; 50% off for 3rd and subsequent children
profile: A small (~190-pupil), non-denominational independent school ('en skole for livet') that treats academic, social, emotional and creative development as equally important, built on a strong sense of community.
waitlist: Open waitlist; parents are explicitly invited to register children for current and future class cohorts.
notes: Grades 0-3: skole 1.249 kr + SFO 1.249 kr + fruit/meals 520 kr = 3.018 kr/month total. Grades 4-9: skole 2.498 kr (SFO/klub folded in) + fruit/meals 520 kr = 3.018 kr/month total (so total monthly cost is the same across all grades, only the split differs). Enrollment fee scales by grade at entry: 0.kl 2.505 kr, 1.kl 4.370 kr, 2.kl 4.632 kr, 3.kl 4.911 kr, 4.-9.kl 5.204 kr (non-refundable). All fees index ~2%/year each 1 January.

name: Thomasskolen
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1.550 kr/month school fee; 3rd child: 760 kr/month; 4th+ child: 170 kr/month (reduced SFO rates for siblings too)
profile: A Christian independent school (kristen friskole) with an open Christian foundation, combining a high academic level, a creative environment and an inclusive community; core values include authenticity, engagement, community, Christian faith, joy of life and security.
notes: School fee paid over 11 months (July exempt). SFO has two components for 1st child: morning (7:00-8:10) 400 kr/month + afternoon (13:05-17:00, Fri to 16:30) 1.600 kr/month (afternoon figure used as sfoMonthlyDKK; add morning if used). Sibling rates lower for both morning and afternoon SFO. Additional one-off camp costs spread over the year: ~1.500 kr total in 4th grade (5th-grade camp) and ~3.500 kr total in 7th-8th grade (international trip). Note: school's main domain thomasskolen.dk was unreachable during research; data taken from mirror site thomasskolen.com and a skoleintra document listing 2025/26 figures.

name: Michael Skolen (grundskolen)
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1.396 kr/month; 3rd and subsequent children: school-fee-free (only a voluntary 100 kr/month gift contribution)
profile: A Rudolf Steiner (Waldorf) school founded in 1976, aiming to develop students' individual life choices through combined intellectual, practical and artistic competencies; the grundskole is exam- and grade-free, treating learning and personal development as intertwined.
gradesOffered: 0-9 (grundskole); school also continues to 10. klasse and a Steiner HF upper-secondary track
waitlist: Admission via a waitlist (venteliste); registration required before a place is offered.
notes: Enrollment fee (1.896 kr, non-refundable) is charged together with the first month's fee. Separate voluntary monthly 'gift contribution' on top of fees: 165 kr (1st child), 105 kr (2nd), 100 kr (3rd+). SFO figure (1.098 kr/month) applies to grades 1.-3. Located on the Herlev/Ballerup border; kindergarten (Brombærhuset) is technically in Ballerup municipality.

name: Herlev Privatskole
siblingDiscount: 2 children: 3.525 kr/month combined; 3 children: 4.975 kr/month combined; no school fee charged for a 4th child if all four attend simultaneously
profile: A non-denominational independent private school (privatskole) founded in 1967, single-track with ~240 pupils, emphasizing individualized instruction, a strong academic record (exam averages well above municipal/national norms) and a value-based, democratic school culture.
waitlist: Operates a waitlist (a 'Venteliste december 2025' document is published for prospective families).
notes: Enrollment/admin fee listed as 'Indmeldelses- & administrationsgebyr' = 750 kr. The school's own site (herlevprivatskole.dk and its Skoleporten-hosted pages) actively blocks automated/bot fetching (403 errors and JS/CAPTCHA challenges); figures were retrieved via a cached rendering of the school's own published 'Skolepenge 2026/27' document, so it is worth spot-checking directly with the school before relying on exact figures.

name: Bernadotteskolen
siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 2.130 kr/month school fee + 1.480 kr/month SFO; 3rd+ child: 1.180 kr/month school fee + 820 kr/month SFO
profile: A private school in Hellerup founded in 1948, two-tracked from pre-school through 9th (plus a 10th grade); alongside its standard Danish-language track it runs 'The Little House', an English-medium International School section (ages 6-15) rooted in the Danish curriculum framework, aiming for bilingual pupils who ultimately sit Danish state exams.
curriculum: Danish (Little House track delivered in English within the Danish curriculum framework)
waitlist: Operates a formal waitlist system ('Ventelisten hoveddokument' published for parents).
notes: School fee paid over all 12 months (incl. July); SFO/'Legestuen' paid over 11 months/year. Minor additional costs noted for class funds and school camps, amount unspecified. No enrollment/indskud fee could be confirmed. Both bernadotteskolen.dk and the school's Skoleporten-hosted pages actively blocked automated fetching (connection refusals and bot/security-verification walls); figures were retrieved via a cached rendering of the school's own fee document, so worth confirming directly with the school.
